# LowBatteryTown (低電量小鎮)

> A free, no-sign-up, anonymous 1-on-1 chat for people with a low "social battery": talk to a real person for about 7 minutes, extend only if both agree, and leave anytime. Traditional Chinese first, also in English. 18+.

LowBatteryTown (低電量小鎮) pairs two real, anonymous people for one short, low-pressure conversation. You pick a "social battery" that tells the other person your reply pace (快沒電了 / 還有一點 / 想說說話) and a chat intent (隨意聊聊 / 有人聽我說 / 聽聽別人的故事). No account and no real name — just an editable nickname. The first window is 7 minutes and extends only when both people agree; you can always leave ("說聲晚安") or report. It is not counselling or an emergency service.

## Key facts

- Free, no sign-up, anonymous; nickname is editable. 18+ (self-declared, enforced server-side).
- Real people only — no bots and no fake head counts. A clearly labelled scripted demo (模擬對象) lives at /demo.
- Works in mobile and desktop browsers. Available in Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) and English (en).
- Not medical or crisis help: the chat and report dialog point to a universal helpline finder (findahelpline.com) and "your local emergency number".
- Reports end the chat, are reviewed, and block that pair for 24 hours.

## Who it is for

People who feel socially drained, lonely, or awake at night and want a few minutes of low-pressure conversation with a stranger — without downloads, accounts, or pressure to keep talking.
